title: LA Colossal – Gamji-geumni 01 (Standing)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Korean woman in her late 40s, black hair in a low jjok-meori bun with a gold binyeo, natural face with a confident smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly hanging in multiple deep overlapping rolls down toward the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips far wider than the shoulders, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body gamji-geumni body painting in the style of Goryeo illuminated sutra covers, from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. Glossy deep navy-indigo base, not purple, with bold dense shimmering gold ink line work — bosang-hwa lotus medallion on the belly, lotus-vine scrolls across the bust, cloud bands on the arms, stacked lotus-petal borders on the legs. No plain indigo areas, no religious figures. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned. Authentic Korean Goryeo style.

Pose: Standing in a three-quarter front view, one arm extended gracefully out to the side at shoulder height, the other hand on her hip, chest open. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch indigo lacquer platform T-strap stiletto sandals with fine gold line straps.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, indigo with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: MANDATORY seamless matte black studio background. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm narrow spotlight with raking side light making the gold lines shimmer. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
